checks.question: Does the 3 m aircraft preserve the source-derived area ratio?
Is scalar thrust zero with power off and positive with power on?
Does doubling airspeed quadruple positive scalar lift?
Does wind matching velocity remove aerodynamic lift?
Does powered phase follow the specified 2 Hz cycle?
Does phase stop with power off?
Does the 2 s steady glide preserve the specified lift/drag ratio?
Does ArrowUp increase pitch by more than 0.1 rad versus neutral?
Does D change heading toward +z by more than 0.02 rad versus neutral?
Does the prescribed sequence sustain flight above both strips?
Does the prescribed approach land safely on both strips?
Do actual wheel meshes avoid ground penetration during both approaches?
Is the actual aircraft nonempty and at most 12,000 triangles?
Is a wing attached on each lateral side, extending across the frame?
Is the tail fin above the aft frame and behind the wing roots?
Are at least two wheels visibly attached below the frame by gear?
Does each outer panel visibly change angle relative to its inner panel?

limitations: Provisional mechanical-v4 smoke test; one task and selected properties, not scientific validation.
The supplied world and UI earn no model points. Aircraft state hooks do not prove all mesh coupling.
Four binary visual checks remain ungraded; automated totals are not full-task scores.
Browser isolation is defense in depth, not a hardened hostile-code sandbox.
